email.body1:
Charles, saw Rewst shipped the RoboRewsty AI Workflow Builder and dropped the 2026 report finding 95 percent of MSPs say automation is no longer optional.

That demand signal opens far more MSPs worth reaching than reps can personally cover. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Rewst off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Charles, quick follow-up for Rewst.

At Series C, board expectations on pipeline climb faster than headcount can, and most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to hit the number. The gap surfaces late, then the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Rewst needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Charles, last bit of proof for Rewst.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Rewst's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Charles, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding reps is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters, and a CRO's calendar rarely cooperates.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an MSP-software motion? I will tailor it to Rewst either way.
